system_thesis_interpretation: V2a remains the narrow option-C causal-interface experiment: a frozen THINK_0 frontier may change only trusted allocation of later bounded public evidence, and success is a postcommit witness-bound provisional proposal closure. It is not final behavior, discovery of an unknown target, online verification, parametric learning, or a general recurrence claim. The two inherited v2 hashes make the inheritance set and four overriding corrections identifiable; they do not release it. This intake is collecting interpretations, its scope explicitly has no authorization effect, required v2a modules/tests are not present, and no exact human ratification or fresh dual review exists.
graph_delta_interpretation: The required graph is PUBLIC VIEW -> generic aliased DREAM -> append-only provisional row -> frozen MEMORY_0/1, with THINK_0 -> trusted selector as the sole treatment edge and MEMORY_1 -> one-way offline scorer -> human stop. The selector tuple, query key, identity, rank, target, stratum, and rationale must be absent from prompt, config, parser, receipt, memory, and provider request bytes. The current adapter is not compliant evidence: it serializes selection_focus, so v2a needs a replacement renderer/request schema rather than a cosmetic test. C aliases are sound only if every visible connector occurrence is rendered as a deterministic call-local C* token, C* maps externally to one connector hash, the raw connector and ledger never enter provider bytes, and parser resolution is call-scoped before score provenance. C* therefore supplies citation identity, not target information. The frozen normalization allowlist belongs only in the isolated scorer; raw relation text remains verbatim in cognition and scorer labels are copies, never memory status.
loop_delta_interpretation: Precommit must enumerate once from frozen public bytes and frozen selector, freeze a field-by-field manifest, then run the originally selected life regardless of class. EXACT means all equality fields and all numeric differences are zero; NEAR means equality fields pass and at least one numeric difference is nonzero but every tolerance passes; OUT_OF_STRATUM covers any failure, missing, or non-finite comparison. EXACT/NEAR alone support the primary own-minus-distractor contrast; OUT_OF_STRATUM still runs and reports but cannot earn distractor-go credit. All DREAM writes, PASSes, and parse failures append and remain provisional; neither raw absence, rejection, normalization, closure, nor scorer rationale can alter a later slot. After all eighteen MEMORY_1 checkpoints and artifact graph freeze, the scorer may normalize a copy, match public witnesses and C bindings, report unmatched strings and separate labels, but has no provider, mutation, scheduling, retry, repair, or promotion edge. Counts are separate ledgers: four seed-0/2 lives at 132 plus two seed-1 lives at 137 gives 802 recurrent DREAM; six THINK_0 runs at at most 12 gives <=72; 6 full-context plus 96 RAG gives 102 additional baseline calls. Shared wake/target-blind checkpoints are attribution-only, never duplicate physical calls. Atomic started/progress/one-terminal markers may resume verified infrastructure barriers but never infer completion, repeat science, or expand authority.
claim_delta_interpretation: The useful outcome is descriptive and conditional: on these named aligned lives, own selector allocation changed later witness-bound provisional closure versus no feedback, and versus the precommitted distractor only for EXACT/NEAR lives. This can test targeted evidence allocation after a supplied non-evidentiary focus; it cannot show independent relation discovery because the selector chooses the view to make that focus useful. Every class, raw proposal rate, normalized-match rate, witness-bound closure, no-feedback delta, distractor delta, control residual, and call/token cost must be reported. Three collision pairs are calibration units, not reliability evidence. No outcome licenses final-answer, behavioral, memory-advantage, transport/LoRA, scaling, replication, headline, or follow-up claims.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: Visibility is coherent only with strict byte-level separation. Precommit and offline score may see exchangeability fields; DREAM and MEMORY commit may not. DREAM may see public content plus E/M/X/N/C handles, but not canonical connector text/IDs, C binding hashes, frontier tuple, stratum, treatment identity, target, private truth, final question, score, or normalization vocabulary. MEMORY retains raw relation strings and resolved external provenance only; it gains neither canonical relation labels nor score status. The scorer alone receives the allowlist, target registry, witness data, aliases, and stratum manifest after the complete commit barrier. Any allowlist-derived token, inferred relation, target tuple, selector metadata, or normalizer result in a cognition-time artifact is a fail-closed leak.
acceptance_test_interpretation: t_v2a_inherited_option_c_contract must execute every v2 gate under v2a identities and prove the four corrections override only conflicts; current selection_focus/online-admission behavior must fail. t_v2a_exact_exchangeability_classes must test each exact field, all <= boundaries, missing/non-finite values, immutable manifest/class, no replacement, and primary-versus-secondary reporting. t_v2a_connector_alias_boundary must prove C rendering redacts canonical connector bytes everywhere provider-visible, has one deterministic call-local binding per visible connector, rejects unknown/duplicate/cross-call/type-wrong aliases, and preserves semantics under alias permutation. t_v2a_maximal_dream_schema_fits_256 must use the locked tokenizer and exact canonical JSON renderer for every operation, reject >192-character text and any output above 256 rather than truncating/repairing. t_v2a_offline_only_relation_normalization must prove raw-string and cognition-byte invariance under allowlist mutation and that only frozen post-MEMORY_1 scorer copies normalize and cannot route work. t_v2a_schedule_baseline_artifact_closure must independently reconcile six heterogeneous lives, 802 recurrent DREAM, <=72 THINK, 102 additional baseline calls, 288 selector traces, 18 MEMORY_1/scorer packets, alias/proposal cardinalities, and crash-safe single-terminal markers while rejecting every omission, duplicate, reorder, or orphan. t_v2a_immutable_dual_review_and_scope must bind exact implementation, tokenizer, formulas, prompts, schemas, allowlist, manifests, workflow, and intake to both fresh reviews and the two v2a scopes. t_v2a_unconditional_human_stop must route every result and infrastructure/integrity failure only to Rohin, with no repair, rerun, replication, LoRA, heldout, claim, external, or spend edge.
assumptions: The v2a workflow is a proposed artifact only; its named v2a implementation, preflight, remote-job, verifier, prompt, schema, and transition-test files remain required before review and cannot be inferred from the workflow references.
The connector renderer replaces connector values inside otherwise visible public records with C* tokens, not merely adds a C* field while leaking the same canonical value elsewhere.
A normalized relation is a scorer-only label on a copied raw proposal and cannot be serialized into a trajectory, prompt cache, selector feature, or future run input.
The inherited 102 baseline calls are exactly 6 full-context and 96 RAG; shared-prefix attribution is reported separately from physical-call totals.

ambiguities.question: What exact token multiset/set operation, denominator, text serialization, special-token policy, and empty-view behavior define lexical overlap?
ambiguities.impact: The <=0.10 exchangeability boundary is not mechanically reproducible until this is frozen.

ambiguities.question: What ordered universe, index origin, tie-breaker, and required-item correspondence define provider position and bounded-memory rank?
ambiguities.impact: The <=1 tolerances and missing-value rule cannot be independently recomputed without these definitions.

ambiguities.question: Which fields of each rendered route/effect record are replaced by C*, and how are connector-bearing concept texts prevented from carrying canonical connector strings?
ambiguities.impact: Without an exact redaction grammar, C* can coexist with the forbidden canonical ID and invalidate selector/provider separation.

ambiguities.question: Does 192 characters mean Unicode code points, grapheme clusters, or UTF-8 units, and what exact JSON escaping/whitespace serializer is tested against the frozen tokenizer?
ambiguities.impact: A purported maximal legal JSON fit may differ between preflight and actual provider bytes.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The inherited hash bindings are unambiguous, but v2a is not presently releasable.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The proposal is unratified and collecting interpretations; its scope denies authorization, and the workflow names required v2a files that do not yet exist. Exact source hashes prevent drift but cannot substitute for implementation, adversarial tests, dual review, or human ratification.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep the intake paused; resolve the four mechanical definitions, implement and validate the full v2a closure, then freeze/review/ratify exact bytes before sync or provider execution.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The word 'exact' overstates the present exchangeability rule.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Lexical-overlap, provider-position, and bounded-memory-rank calculations lack the formula and ordering details necessary to decide boundary cases independently.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add a hash-bound preflight specification containing canonical input serialization, metric formulas, ordering/ties, numeric representation, and manifest schema; its tests must use below/equal/above and missing/non-finite cases.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The current DREAM adapter cannot be reused as the v2a provider boundary.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: It serializes selection_focus and includes an online support-admission design, both prohibited by inherited option C and v2a.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Implement a separate v2a generic renderer/parser with structural forbidden-field scans and exact-provider-byte tests; do not rely on a filter around the existing request.
